boundaries: XCTest uses authored filesystem fixtures only. No app launch, permission prompt, real Trash, personal scan or native UI is exercised.
The package has a local ad-hoc signature, not Developer ID, notarization or an installable release.
Direct children and their original process groups are checked; separately detached sessions and system tool caches are not inventoried.
Userspace deadlines cannot interrupt a blocked kernel filesystem call. GitHub owns final runner teardown.
No app launch, picker/sandbox enforcement, real Trash, personal folder scan, native UI or reclaimed-space acceptance.
No downloadable artifact, Developer ID, notarization, installer/store release or trusted distribution.
The first failed run did not retain the exact rejected ancestor; the normalization mechanism is source-supported inference, followed by passing regression checks.
The packager's legacy-marker recognition/rollback path was source-reviewed; CI packaged only fresh task-owned output.
A captured-self concurrency warning remains in the package's current Swift language mode; Swift 6 language-mode migration was not attempted.
